slides.title: Replit
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Replit, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Replit is a browser-based coding platform where you can write, run, and host software without installing anything.
Its AI Agent can build entire apps from a description, while still letting you (or a developer) edit the code.
There's a free tier to learn and experiment, with paid plans (and Lenny's bundle) for more Agent power and hosting.
slides.narration: Replit is a browser-based coding platform where you can write, run, and host software without installing anything. Its AI Agent can build entire apps from a description, while still letting you (or a developer) edit the code. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: teach coding in the browser with nothing to install on school Chromebooks
SMB owners: build and host a small internal app, with the option to bring in a developer later
Community leaders: prototype a data dashboard for your program's metrics
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can teach coding in the browser with nothing to install on school Chromebooks; SMB owners can build and host a small internal app, with the option to bring in a developer later; Community leaders can prototype a data dashboard for your program's metrics.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
